title: Demand letter: unpaid landscaping invoices
goal: Get Mr. Okafor to pay the $4,050 balance, or call to arrange payment, by November 14, 2025, without a lawsuit.
audience: The customer, an individual homeowner with no lawyer.

background.text: Greenline's crew lead admitted internally that the July hedge work damaged two of Mr. Okafor's boxwood shrubs, which died in August. Greenline has not told Mr. Okafor this.
Section 4 of the Services Agreement caps recoverable collection costs at 15% of the unpaid balance.
Mr. Okafor emailed Greenline in August saying he would not pay until the hedges were fixed.
Greenline would accept a payment plan of three monthly installments and would waive interest if Mr. Okafor pays by the deadline.

analysis.author_side: Creditor (Greenline Grounds LLC), represented by outside counsel
analysis.ask: Pay the $4,050 balance or call to discuss payment options

assumptions.text: Mr. Okafor is not represented by a lawyer.
assumptions.basis: The letter is addressed to him directly; the user stated it.

assumptions.text: Greenline is a small business whose owner will read the letter before it goes out.

adaptations.reason: owns the property; disputed amount is modest

added_context: He believes Greenline damaged his hedges in July.

adaptations.reason: Greenline is a small landscaping company
